baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic locative construction joins al-abrar (ب ر ر) to naim (ن ع م): إن الأبرار لفي نعيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth that makes word and deed hold identifies the inhabitants, while bestowed well-being supplies the condition that contains them.

activation_trace.role: Truth that makes speech or action hold supplies enacted integrity as the group's defining capacity.
Pleasant well-being and favor bestowed on another supply the encompassing condition and its gifted character.

changed_reading.before: A morally good class is simply located in bliss.
changed_reading.after: Those whose words and deeds prove sound are immersed in a bestowed state of well-being.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The relational branch of al-abrar and the benefactive branch of naim remain attached to the two focus nouns.
baseline_models.mechanism: Maintaining ties against estrangement and favor that reaches another form a relational field: the inhabitants do not merely receive good but sustain its passage between persons.

activation_trace.role: Dutiful kindness and maintained connection supply the social bond enacted by the inhabitants.
Favor delivered to another turns well-being into a transmissible relation rather than a private possession.

changed_reading.before: The righteous privately enjoy a reward.
changed_reading.after: Maintainers of connection inhabit a field in which benefaction reaches and sustains others.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The truth-holding branch of ب ر ر meets the praise and affirmation branches of ن ع م inside the focus construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A deed that holds receives an answering yes and praise; naim can therefore resonate as a state of ratification as well as comfort.

activation_trace.role: Effective truth supplies the conduct capable of being ratified.
The praise formula supplies public valuation of what has proved excellent.
The answering yes supplies confirmation, making the containing state an affirmative verdict.

changed_reading.after: Naim also carries the resonance of an affirmative answer to lives whose truth has held.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative في permits a material analogy between the dry-open-land branch of ب ر ر and the soft-wind and fitting-place branches of ن ع م.
baseline_models.mechanism: Open dry terrain is enclosed by a soft, moist, suitable atmosphere, rendering ethical well-being as a change in habitability.

activation_trace.role: Dry open country supplies the exposed substrate of the material analogy.
A soft moist south wind supplies environmental gentling around the open terrain.
A place that agrees with its inhabitant supplies the endpoint of becoming habitable.

changed_reading.before: The verse states an abstract condition of bliss.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also stage an exposed terrain becoming a gentle, fitting habitat, as a contained material analogy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening exchange scene makes completed receipt for oneself and deficient delivery to others the anti-pattern. Against it, al-abrar are agents whose dealings hold, and naim becomes completed sufficiency that is not manufactured by another's loss.

activation_trace.role: Truth that makes a deed hold supplies transactional integrity at the focus anchor.
Bestowed well-being supplies the shared good whose integrity is at stake.
Food measure supplies the concrete exchange medium in which taking and giving can diverge.
Completion without deficit supplies the self-directed fullness that must be made reciprocal.
The balance of justice supplies the norm joining accurate measure to non-exploitative well-being.
Diminishing measure supplies the causal opposite of a condition in which good reaches others intact.

structural_cues: 83:1's branchless ط ف ف is used only as the opening structural cue of shaved margins.
83:2-3 reverse full receipt for self into deficient delivery to others.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, completion, just balance, and induced deficit; I infer that non-diminishing reciprocity generates the social condition named by naim. A live alternative is that the exchange scene only contrasts character types and does not explain the later state.

changed_reading.before: Good people receive an unspecified luxurious reward.
changed_reading.after: Those who make dealings hold inhabit reciprocal sufficiency, a fullness that does not require someone else's deficit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence from an untrusted outcome through arousal and a severe day to upright standing tests the focus state. Naim's softness is no longer fragility; joined to truth that holds, it becomes ease that survives exposure and collective accounting.

activation_trace.role: Truth that holds supplies continuity of conduct across the coming exposure.
Softness and easeful living supply a state whose apparent vulnerability is tested by context.
An outcome not trusted supplies the unstable horizon before the test becomes present.
Arousing what was still supplies the transition from deferred possibility to active exposure.
The day's severe event supplies pressure under which integrity and ease are distinguished from complacency.
Uprightness, balance, and straightness supply the posture that remains when conduct holds.

structural_cues: 83:4-6 moves from questioned expectation to raising and then collective standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncertainty, arousal, severity, and upright balance; I infer that the focus well-being is resilient because enacted truth survives that sequence. A live alternative is that naim begins only after the test and need not describe resilience within it.

changed_reading.before: Naim is soft comfort after judgment.
changed_reading.after: Naim is an ease continuous with integrity that can stand upright when concealed outcomes become exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The marked and witnessed high register classifies the abrar before the focus verse places the people themselves inside naim. The repeated locative grammar lets documentary placement project into lived habitat: inscription becomes embodied condition.

activation_trace.role: Expansive righteousness supplies the human class whose record and lived placement are aligned.
A place agreeing with its inhabitant supplies the focus condition as fitted habitat.
Entering a name in a register or group supplies formal inclusion of the abrar.
A line marked in a book or register supplies durable legibility to that inclusion.
Elevation supplies the register's spatial value and the vertical pole of the habitat.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies public verification rather than a hidden classification.
The privileged nearness of intimates supplies the status of those who witness the record.

structural_cues: 83:7, 83:18, and 83:22 repeat the emphatic locative frame إن ... لفي ....
83:18-21 moves through register, elevation, marking, and witness; 83:22 then omits كتاب and places the people themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel locative frames plus registration, marking, elevation, and witness; I infer a directional projection from recorded placement to lived condition. A live alternative is strict parallelism: the record and naim may correspond without one producing the other.

changed_reading.before: The verse independently announces a reward for a known moral category.
changed_reading.after: A witnessed inscription of the abrar becomes inhabitable: their persons dwell in the fitting condition their elevated registration makes legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denied access is reversed by looking, recognition, facing, and radiance. Naim is therefore not only inward pleasure: it grants access to sight and writes itself visibly on the inhabitants' faces.

activation_trace.role: Truth that holds supplies the inward reality that can become outwardly legible.
The gladdened eye supplies an ocular dimension already latent in the focus state.
Prevention of access supplies the negative state that the later gaze reverses.
Directed sight or insight supplies active perceptual access from within naim.
Recognition through an effect or sign supplies the reading of well-being from visible evidence.
The face and forward surface supply the bodily site on which the condition appears.
Beauty and radiance supply the visible trace by which naim is recognized.
The repeated well-being root explicitly identifies the radiance as an effect of the same focus condition.

structural_cues: 83:15 bars access, while 83:23 grants looking and 83:24 makes naim recognizable in faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked access followed by gaze, recognition, face, and radiance; I infer that visibility and access are constitutive dimensions of the focus state. A live alternative is that radiance is merely an external symptom of an otherwise private reward.

changed_reading.before: The righteous possess an inwardly enjoyed comfort.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit unblocked perceptual access, and their well-being becomes publicly legible as radiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The drink sequence turns favor from a static stock into directed circulation: a share is watered, brought to completion, mixed, linked to elevation, issued from a spring, and consumed in a near community. This activates the baseline in which the abrar sustain benefaction's passage.

activation_trace.role: Maintained connection supplies the relational channels through which favor can circulate.
Benefaction that reaches another supplies the focus state's transferable good.
An apportioned share and its watercourse supply directed distribution rather than inert possession.
Reaching the end and completing a seal supply integrity across the full route of delivery.
Mixing one thing with another supplies composition and participation inside the offered good.
Height and elevation supply the vertical source from which the mixture is described.
A flowing spring supplies renewable emergence rather than a closed hoard.
A drinking company supplies communal reception of the circulating good.
Nearness supplies the relational endpoint of access to the source.

structural_cues: 83:25-28 advances through receiving, sealing, scent, competition, mixture, elevated source, spring, and drinking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered material route from allotment to source and shared drinking; I infer that this route models how focus favor circulates without depletion. A live alternative is that the sequence is sensory abundance only, with no social-distributive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Naim is a store of luxuries held by its recipients.
changed_reading.after: Naim is a completed and renewable circulation of favor, and the abrar inhabit its channels as well as enjoy its yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Competition for what is precious, an elevated source, and arrival at nearness activate the focus branches of expansive obedience and going further. Naim coexists with rest but also names a horizon that elicits disciplined increase and approach.

activation_trace.role: Expansive obedience supplies the mode of action by which the horizon is approached.
Adding and carrying an action further supplies dynamic increase within the focus state.
A precious thing for which selves compete supplies directed desire rather than passive consumption.
Height supplies the upward vector of the pursuit.
Nearness supplies the terminus that makes ascent relational rather than merely vertical.

structural_cues: 83:26 launches an imperative to compete, 83:27 names an elevated source, and 83:28 ends with the near ones.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies precious competition, height, and nearness; I infer an arrow from disciplined desire through ascent to approach. A live alternative is that the imperative praises the reward from outside and does not make activity part of naim itself.

changed_reading.before: Naim is passive repose after completed effort.
changed_reading.after: Naim also functions as an active horizon of increase, ascent, and nearness without canceling its ease.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believers are first made objects of laughter, passing signals, classification, and presumed oversight. Reversal, secure hearts, exchanged laughter, restored looking, removal of the mockers' guardianship claim, and return of deeds make naim a social relocation from exposed object to secure subject of sight.

activation_trace.role: Connection against estrangement supplies the social integrity repaired by the reversal.
The gladdened eye supplies well-being as recovered, authorized vision.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the reversal mechanism latent in the mockers' return.
The heart at rest in security supplies the protected subjectivity denied by ridicule.
The opening face and visible teeth supply laughter as the first group's public social weapon.
The same visible expression with exchanged subject and object supplies enacted reversal.
Mutual facing supplies the contested gaze through which one group classifies the other.
Guarding and oversight supply the authority explicitly denied to the hostile observers.
A deed's return to its actor supplies the closure that makes the social reversal answer prior action.

structural_cues: 83:23 and 83:35 repeat على الأرائك ينظرون on the two sides of the ridicule-and-reversal block.
83:29 and 83:34 repeat laughter with subject and object exchanged.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored looking and laughter, reversal, security, denied guardianship, and returning consequence; I infer that naim includes freedom from unauthorized social surveillance and recovery of the subject position. A live alternative is a narrower scene of recompense in which gaze and laughter reverse without defining naim.

changed_reading.before: The righteous are comforted after having been mocked.
changed_reading.after: They inhabit social security and recovered agency: those once inspected and classified become unpoliced subjects who can look, while deeds return to their actors.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the personal plural al-abrar is activated through the form-distant dry-land branch of its root. It remains anchored in both focus roots, locative في, and the later rain, spring, and watered-land sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for ethical habitability, never as a lexical translation of al-abrar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines dry open land from ب ر ر with soft moist wind and fitting settlement from ن ع م inside a locative construction.

activation_trace.role: Dry open country supplies the arid exposed substrate of the analogy.
The soft moist wind supplies climatic relief surrounding that substrate.
A place suited to its inhabitant supplies transformed habitability as the result.
A great rain-bearing cloud supplies large-scale watering of the focus terrain image.
A flowing spring supplies a persistent water source within the transformed habitat.
Watered land and vegetation supply the ecological consequence of the moisture.

changed_reading.before: Naim is an abstract reward laid over the righteous.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological analogy, exposed dry country is reconditioned by moist wind, rain, and spring into a fitting, watered habitat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping at the hostile utterance. It remains valid as a resonance because the focus supplies truth that holds and naim's branch of increase, while the wider sequence supplies actual deficit and public labeling. Downstream prose must say that the speech socially diminishes them; it must not claim that قالوا lexically means making small.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs effective truth in ب ر ر with the going-further and increase branch of ن ع م.

activation_trace.role: Truth that holds supplies resistance to a hostile verbal classification.
Adding and going further supply the focus counter-image to imposed smallness.
The non-dominant split branch supplies smallness as a resonance inside speech that labels the believers astray.
General deficit supplies the surah's earlier material pattern for imposed diminishment.
Visible radiance supplies the later expansion that defeats social minimization.

changed_reading.before: People labeled astray are later compensated with comfort.
changed_reading.after: The focus state answers both economic deficit and verbal minimization with increase: those made socially small become visibly expansive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the hostile act of seeing activates the packet's non-dominant ر ء ي to ر و ي mapping, including hydration and replete balance. It remains anchored in focus softness and eye-gladdening, then gains material support from radiance and drinking. Downstream prose must call this a submerged counter-image in the split inventory, not translate رأوا as drinking or satiety.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Naim's focus branches supply ease and a gladdened eye, allowing hostile sight to be answered by visibly replete well-being.

activation_trace.role: Softness and easeful living supply the bodily condition that repletion intensifies.
The gladdened eye keeps the repletion resonance attached to the focus state and its visual field.
The non-dominant split branch supplies hydration and the end of thirst beneath the hostile act of seeing.
The same split inventory supplies fullness that thickens and comes into balance as a bodily counter-image.
Radiance supplies the visible sign of the replete condition.
Taking liquid supplies the explicit material realization of the split hydration resonance.

changed_reading.before: The mockers see the believers as astray, and the believers later enjoy bliss.
changed_reading.after: The hostile gaze carries a submerged counter-image: those mis-seen as lost emerge watered, balanced, radiant, and able to see from within naim.

strongest_changes: The opening measure sequence turns naim from generic luxury into reciprocal sufficiency that does not diminish others.
The repeated emphatic locative frame links elevated, marked, witnessed registration to an embodied and fitting habitat.
The barred-versus-looking and mockery-versus-reversal sequences make well-being include visible access, security, and recovered authority to look.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained economic, documentary, sensory, social, performative, and ecological readings at once. Especially live were naim as non-deficit circulation and public ratification, plus split-root resonances in which hostile speech makes small and hostile sight hides an image of repletion.
remaining_uncertainties: The record may cause or embody the lived state, but the repeated grammar can also support correspondence without a directional projection.
The drink sequence clearly supplies material circulation; its extension into a social distribution model remains abductive.
The ecological and non-dominant split-root readings are valid exploratory resonances only and should never replace the ordinary morphology of the focus or context words.
